name: histopilot
description: Operate a HistoPilot service from Claude Code: MCP tools and the histopilot skill read studies, cross-validated results, predictor runs and the Task Center, and prepare experiments and Apply models runs. Every change waits for a person.

service_url.title: HistoPilot service URL
service_url.description: Your running service on loopback, such as http://127.0.0.1:8788. Empty: HISTOPILOT_URL, else http://127.0.0.1:8787.

token.title: Agent token
token.description: A scoped hpt_ token for one project, from `histopilot token create` or the AI agent access panel. Kept in your OS keychain.

histopilot_command.title: histopilot executable (optional)
histopilot_command.description: A histopilot with the agent extra, such as /path/to/HistoPilot/.venv-agent/bin/histopilot. Empty: run HistoPilot from GitHub with uvx.
